configuration_yaml:
---
# Hazard discovery, not a style policy. See docs/findings/cppgw-clang-tidy-audit-20261117.md.
InheritParentConfig: false
Checks: >-
  -*,
  bugprone-*,
  -bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters,
  cppcoreguidelines-avoid-capturing-lambda-coroutines,
  cppcoreguidelines-avoid-reference-coroutine-parameters,
  misc-coroutine-hostile-raii,
  cert-*,
  -cert-dcl37-c,
  -cert-dcl51-cpp,
  performance-*,
  -performance-avoid-endl,
  -performance-enum-size,
  concurrency-*,
  clang-analyzer-core.*,
  clang-analyzer-cplusplus.*,
  clang-analyzer-optin.cplusplus.*,
  clang-analyzer-security.*,
  clang-analyzer-unix.*
# Adjacent same-type parameters are deliberate module-for-module TS API translations.
# Reserved identifiers are naming/style issues outside this lifetime audit (cert-dcl37/51).
# endl and enum storage size are micro-style suggestions, not hot-path copy hazards.
WarningsAsErrors: ''
HeaderFilterRegex: '(^|/)cpp/gateway/(include|src|tests)/'
SystemHeaders: false
FormatStyle: none
CheckOptions:
  bugprone-dangling-handle.HandleClasses: 'std::basic_string_view;std::span'
  bugprone-unchecked-optional-access.IgnoreSmartPointerDereference: 'false'
  bugprone-exception-escape.CheckDestructors: 'true'
  bugprone-exception-escape.CheckMoveMemberFunctions: 'true'
  bugprone-narrowing-conversions.WarnOnIntegerNarrowingConversion: 'true'
  bugprone-narrowing-conversions.WarnOnIntegerToFloatingPointNarrowingConversion: 'true'
  bugprone-narrowing-conversions.WarnOnFloatingPointNarrowingConversion: 'true'
  performance-unnecessary-value-param.AllowedTypes: ''
counting: Unique (check/alias-group, gateway-relative file, line, column, message); repeated header emissions deduplicated. TU emissions also counted separately.
